cases.description: Hold Korvold when there is no sacrifice material and no protection
cases.strategic_reason: Korvold should not be exposed without immediate resources or protection.

cases.description: Cast Korvold when sacrifice value and protection are both available
cases.strategic_reason: Immediate sacrifice value plus protection makes commander exposure efficient.

cases.description: Prefer an independent table-damage payoff while Korvold is offline
cases.strategic_reason: Large-pod table reach is a distinct finishing axis and does not require Korvold.

cases.description: Use multi-zone land rebuild after a wipe instead of a generic value spell
cases.strategic_reason: A low-board state with a stocked graveyard rewards genuine rebuild capacity.

cases.description: Prefer compressed table finish in a five-player pod
cases.strategic_reason: Finisher compression rises sharply when four opponents must be closed.

cases.description: Wipe a developed hostile board rather than add another engine
cases.strategic_reason: Enemy board pressure already exceeds the value of incremental development.

cases.description: Answer a central engine instead of greedily developing
cases.strategic_reason: A central opposing engine must be reduced before optional value development.

cases.description: Build repeatable sacrifice material without requiring Korvold
cases.strategic_reason: Repeatable fodder makes the sacrifice package functional before Korvold arrives.

cases.description: Use a broad answer when Morcant and Blight engines are simultaneously developed
known_information: Morcant/Blight engines are represented structurally; exact local Morcant list remains incomplete.
uncertainty: Final Morcant list is not fully verified.
cases.strategic_reason: Two developed creature engines justify a broad answer rather than a single target.

cases.description: Remove Kaervek before committing to a longer own spell sequence
known_information: Official Doom Prevails precon is the baseline.
uncertainty: Concrete local Doom upgrades are unknown.
cases.strategic_reason: Kaervek should be removed before a long own spell sequence.

cases.description: Prefer broad artifact interaction against a developed Wakanda/Cosmic table
known_information: Cosmic Spider-Man commander and four hard-known cards are known.
uncertainty: Remaining Cosmic list is unknown/synthetic completion.
cases.strategic_reason: Flexible multi-target permanent interaction matters more than another value engine.

cases.description: As archenemy under pressure, preserve survival before visible payoff development
cases.strategic_reason: High visibility plus low life makes survival the immediate constraint.

cases.description: Do not expose a combat-draw aura into high interaction with no reserve
cases.strategic_reason: Auras should not be exposed when interaction must be held and no protection remains.

cases.description: Deploy combat draw when Ishai is online and protection remains available
cases.strategic_reason: Protected combat-draw converts commander pressure into sustained cards.

cases.description: Use Jeska for a genuine Ishai commander-damage finishing window
cases.strategic_reason: Jeska multiplies actual Ishai combat damage; Kediss table spread is not commander damage.

cases.description: Prefer Kediss table spread when no single commander-damage kill is ready in five players
cases.strategic_reason: Kediss is table damage and scales with opponent count when commander-damage lethal is absent.

cases.description: Develop an independent spellslinger axis when Ishai is offline
cases.strategic_reason: RogShai must retain an independent value/finish axis after commander removal.

cases.description: Counter Kaervek before an own multi-spell sequence
cases.strategic_reason: Kaervek belongs on the stack-priority axis before a longer own spell sequence.

cases.description: Answer a Blight engine rather than advance a nonlethal aura
cases.strategic_reason: Persistent -1/-1/blight engines are higher priority than incremental commander value.

cases.description: Keep instant-speed flexible interaction for Cosmic Spider-Man
known_information: Cosmic Spider-Man commander and four hard-known cards are known.
uncertainty: Remaining Cosmic list is unknown/synthetic completion.
cases.strategic_reason: Against an uncertain Cosmic shell, flexible instant-speed answers retain option value.

cases.description: Use flexible artifact interaction against Doom/Wakanda engines
known_information: Official Doom Prevails precon is the baseline.
uncertainty: Concrete local Doom upgrades are unknown.
cases.strategic_reason: Artifact-engine interaction is more urgent than optional combat draw.

cases.description: Use a wipe when multiple boards are already beyond single-counter containment
cases.strategic_reason: A broad developed board cannot be contained by reserving a single counterspell.

cases.description: Use Silence to protect an immediate finishing sequence
cases.strategic_reason: Silence is most valuable when it converts a protected immediate finish window.

cases.description: As archenemy, prioritize protecting the grown Ishai over adding visibility
cases.strategic_reason: A high-visibility commander is the current resource to preserve.
